'''Saml Previl''' was a man that held the rank of [[Prime Abseiler of Alsakan]] in the Kingdom of [[Archais (kingdom)|Archais]] many years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The ancient man supposedly rode the [[Tessent of Alsakan]] into battle against the dukes of the [[Ten Valleys]]. Following his defeat of the dukes, Previl and his descendants united the tribes of Alsakan.<ref name="Tessent" />
